Two-colour fill palette of an MHC class

Source: R/report-helpers.R
mhc_class_palette.Rd

The selected-vs-other length fill used across the report plots. "MHC1_mouse" shares the "MHC1" palette (the same class, a different species); an unrecognised class also falls back to it.

Usage

mhc_class_palette(mhcclass = "MHC1")

Arguments

mhcclass

One of "MHC1", "MHC1_mouse", "MHC2".

Value

A length-2 character vector of hex colours, c(in_window, other).

Examples

mhc_class_palette("MHC2")
#> [1] "#21918c" "#440154"
